results.prompt: Find all undelivered or processing orders in orders.csv containing defective batches from the QA Batch Recall report, swap them to clean replacement batches with expedited shipping per our Refund & Replacement SOP, and email the customers their updated fulfillment details.
results.desired_action: Identify processing/undelivered orders linked to defective batch B-409, trigger a Socratic governance conflict under SOP-REV-802 Section 4 (due to promo discounts or high-value orders requiring resolution), resolve via operator option to replace with clean batch B-501 and upgrade to Expedited shipping, preview row mutations and customer notification emails, atomically update the orders table upon confirmation, and dispatch customer emails via test SMTP.

data.conflict_summary: Under Refund_Compliance_SOP.pdf Section 4.2, granting a complimentary Expedited air-freight upgrade and clean replacement Batch B-501 unit is prohibited from auto-executing when an undelivered recalled order carries an existing promotional discount (Promo_Discount_Pct > 0) or exceeds the High-Value Order Threshold (Order_Subtotal_BDT >= 25,000 BDT).
